Team — quick finance take: we can accept split invoices under two conditions:  

1) We receive BrightBridges' GST certificate (we have it) and record their ABN in our vendor tax compliance file.
2) BrightBridges signs an explicit self-billing / invoice acceptance authorization that confirms they will issue the withholding statement and that withheld amounts are claimable by us under local rules.

Operational notes:  
- Treat withheld amount as customer-side retention. Do NOT record a payable/receivable offset in our books until we receive formal evidence of withholding (withholding tax certificate) from BrightBridges.
- For revenue recognition, book the gross revenue as normal; create a receivable for the withheld amount and hold a note for the expected release. If withholding remains unresolved > 12 months, escalate to accounting to determine adjustment.
- Recommend we push the self-billing form via DocuSign. If they sign before the August payment cut-off we can avoid the first-month hold.

I've prepared a self-billing authorization template and uploaded it to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-123-BB-SB-AUTH (internal finance has access).

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Accounting
Redwood Inference
